product_one_liner.value: WellnessLiving provides wellness, fitness, health, and beauty businesses with all-in-one software for bookings, client management, payments, marketing, loyalty programs, reporting, and AI-powered business tools.

founded_year.notes: Uses the company's own stated founding year; some third-party databases report 2012.

eng_blog.notes: The blog contains business, marketing, product, release-note, and employee-profile content; the engineering-leader profiles do not establish two engineer-authored technical build posts.

public_docs.notes: A public Help Center contains multiple articles, and its API guide links to a developer portal with endpoint references and tutorials.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: AI Solutions Engineer, posted August 7, 2026, with an active Apply Now control.

model_provider.value: OpenAI GPT-4 for Isaac; Google Gemini for CAASI.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims a SOC 2 Type 2 report, HIPAA audits, and GDPR-related privacy-law compliance. GDPR is not a standalone certification. ISO 27001 is attributed to AWS; PCI DSS attestations are attributed to payment-processing partners.

last_funding.notes: McCarthy Capital led the $46 million minority equity investment announced August 16, 2022. Concurrent CIBC growth financing added $20 million, making the combined equity-and-debt package US$66 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded financing was announced August 16, 2022, before the window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Business Development Representative, posted November 9, 2026, with an active Apply Now control.

launched_6mo.notes: The official blog lists July 2026 Health & Beauty release highlights for version 26.74, a release-type item within the requested window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The appointments found occurred before the requested window. The public leadership page does not provide a complete executive roster with tenure dates, so neither a recent change nor its absence could be established.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Sales Operations Manager posting requires configuring Zoho CRM; the BDR posting requires managing the sales pipeline in Salesforce.
